# What the real replies become

Written by `tst_golden` (`ACQ_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1`); do not edit by hand. One file
for each reply in `../payloads`, and `census.txt` for all of them together.
`tests/corpusdump.h` says what is written and `BUILD.md`, "Golden files", how
the files are used.

These files pin what the application does today. Where that is a defect,
the fix shows here as a changed line.
